checks.name: Six approved viewports
checks.detail: 12 teacher page/viewport combinations at 1440, 1366, 1024, 768, 390 and 320px with no horizontal overflow, no clipped controls and a full-width header

checks.name: Header at the narrowest desktop width
checks.detail: Four header items stay on one row at 768px on index, lessons, teacher and teacher-resources pages with 66–120px between brand and navigation, no internal scrolling and exactly one current item

checks.name: Mobile drawer
checks.detail: Below 768px both teacher pages hide the desktop bar, open a four-destination drawer that marks Teachers as current, and close on Escape with focus restored

checks.name: Breadcrumb trail
checks.detail: teacher.html shows Home → Teacher Portal and teacher-resources.html shows Home → Teacher Portal → Teacher Resources, with the correct parent links

checks.name: Teacher link resolution
checks.detail: 64 distinct local destinations from the two teacher pages all returned HTTP 200, including every lesson page and every template route

checks.name: Published key anchors
checks.detail: Four lesson tests deep-link to #teacher-gate, each lands with the key area in view and keeps the answer container hidden until it is unlocked

checks.name: Pages without a key anchor
checks.detail: Grade 4 Lesson 1 has no key area, and the Grade 5 Lesson 2 and Grade 8 Lesson 1 key areas keep their existing heading and password field untouched, with no anchor invented

checks.name: No prompts and no storage writes
checks.detail: Both teacher pages contain zero inputs and zero forms, and the Continue-learning key in browser storage is byte-identical after visiting them

checks.name: Honest disclosure
checks.detail: Both pages state that the shared classroom password is not authentication, neither claims protection, and the open answer reveals are disclosed as visible to pupils

checks.name: Rendered status matrix
checks.detail: Seven rows with the expected columns, one “Not published” key and “None” for every listening key

checks.name: Keyboard access
checks.detail: The skip link is the first Tab stop and targets the main landmark; header links, the Teachers item and page buttons are all reachable and show a visible focus outline

checks.name: Reduced motion and print
checks.detail: Reduced motion removes smooth scrolling and button transitions; print hides the header and contact strip so the directory prints cleanly

checks.name: Browser and HTTP health
checks.detail: Zero JavaScript page errors, zero console errors and no HTTP status of 400 or above on any tested route
